info.name: FolderBulkDeleteResource
info.description:
Postman collection for POST /api/v1/assets/folders/_bulkdelete (#37063).

Requests added under T018 (US1 tests). Covers the happy path and the two 400 refusals reachable at US1 scope; the 403 (NOT_ENTITLED) and 409 (OVERLAPPING_RUN) refusals belong to later stories and are added there. This collection is what actually verifies the exception-mapper wiring end to end - BulkUploadRefusedExceptionMapper's own history records a real refusal-status bug that helper-level integration tests alone missed and only Postman caught.

Contract: specs/37063-bulk-folder-delete-backend/contracts/bulk-delete-api.md

item.name: Accepts a selection and answers 202 with a handle

request.description: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003 - answers immediately with a handle, before any folder is deleted.
FR-004 - an empty submission is refused before a job is created, distinguishable by errorCode from an over-the-maximum refusal (also 400) per the CR-02 gap raised on the issue.

item.name: Refuses a selection over the configured maximum

request.description: FR-004, FR-007 - 51 paths against the default ceiling of 50 (contracts §5). Refused before resolving any path, so nonexistent folder names are fine here.
